observations.statement: The ordinance requires policies, notice, evidence access, an internal challenge process, and quarterly aggregate reporting.
During the transition through 31 May 2027, OLS enforces procedure rather than the permissibility of the underlying reason.
Workers retain an internal challenge window and a private-action path.
Q4 2025 public summaries record process restarts, reinstatements or reactivations, and payments across several companies.
Those outcomes are concrete individual and procedural remedies rather than merits findings.
The public record does not establish revision of platform models, thresholds, deactivation triggers, or survivor-conditioned validation.

open_questions: Was the correction implemented at the operative system boundary?

title: Seattle deactivation rights: concrete restoration versus platform-system learning
